name: Sentry (Self-Hosted)
description: Deploy self-hosted Sentry error tracking. Choose Starter (EC2 docker-compose, ~$45/mo) for dev/small teams or Optimized (Fargate + RDS + ElastiCache, ~$150-300/mo) for production workloads.

tier.title: Deployment Tier
tier.description: Starter: single EC2 with Docker Compose (~$45/mo). Optimized: ECS Fargate + managed RDS/Redis (~$150-300/mo).

sentryProfile.title: Sentry Profile
sentryProfile.description: errors-only runs ~15 containers (lighter). full runs all ~74 services.

instanceType.title: Instance Type
instanceType.description: EC2 instance type. Minimum t3.xlarge (4 CPU, 16 GB RAM) required.

volumeSizeGb.title: EBS Volume Size (GB)
volumeSizeGb.description: Root volume size in GB. 100 GB recommended for production use.

sentryEventRetentionDays.title: Event Retention (Days)
sentryEventRetentionDays.description: How long to retain Sentry events. Longer retention requires more disk space.

sshKeyName.title: SSH Key Pair Name
sshKeyName.description: Optional EC2 key pair for SSH access. Leave empty to use SSM Session Manager.

webCpu.title: Web Service CPU
webCpu.description: Fargate CPU units for the Sentry web service (256 = 0.25 vCPU).

webMemory.title: Web Service Memory (MiB)
webMemory.description: Fargate memory for the Sentry web service.

dbMultiAz.title: RDS Multi-AZ
dbMultiAz.description: Enable Multi-AZ deployment for high availability. Doubles RDS cost.

vpcMode.title: VPC Mode
vpcMode.description: Create a new VPC or use an existing one.

vpcId.title: Existing VPC ID
vpcId.description: VPC ID to deploy into (e.g., vpc-0abc123def456).

subnetType.title: Subnet Type
subnetType.description: Public: accessible from internet. Private: VPC-only access (Optimized tier defaults to private).

domainName.title: Custom Domain
domainName.description: Optional custom domain (e.g., sentry.example.com). Starter: HTTPS via Caddy/Let's Encrypt. Optimized: HTTPS via ACM certificate.

hostedZoneId.title: Route 53 Hosted Zone ID
hostedZoneId.description: Hosted zone for DNS record creation.
